requests.tradeoff: Under 400px the header wraps to two rows, header links and buttons get a 44px minimum box, and Hangul wraps with keep-all so words break only at spaces. Desktop and tablet layouts are unchanged. Room cards keep their existing layout.

Language is stored in localStorage key mol-lang. With no saved choice, navigator.language starting with en gives English; anything else gives Korean (the primary language). The toggle is a native button, so Enter and Space work. The public lang.toggle probe assumes a Korean start, so it scores 2 of 5 in the en-US default context; this follows the first-visit rule and was not changed.

Only [data-bench="hero-title"] changes, to a font-family stack with a Korean serif (Batang / 바탕) and generic serif fallbacks. No font files are downloaded, so the offline gate is unaffected. Size, color and layout are unchanged.

Each room card gets a live CSS 3D prism in its accent color; the angle is a pure function of the harness clock, and it stops under reduced motion. No WebGL, libraries or downloads. Cards grow about 108px. The faster first load is NOT delivered: no speedup was made and LCP cannot be measured here (Lighthouse is a stub).
